{{Quote|The submarines are surfacing and attacking our bombers!|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] during the [[Battle of Dubrillion (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Dubrillion]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>}}
The sleek '''Imperial submarine''' was deployed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]] to defend the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-based [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] [[Dubrillion superlaser facility|facility]] against [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] and the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] during the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Battle of Dubrillion (Galactic Civil War)|assault on the planet]].

==Characteristics==
The Imperial submarines deployed from the aquatic facility on Dubrillion were vital in the Empire's defensive forces, able to quickly emerge to the [[Water/Legends|water's]] surface and attack the Alliance's aerial forces using powerful homing missiles.

They were able to travel across the surface at amazing speeds, and were difficult to spot from high in the air. Though the submarines did not have any [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], a starfighter or bomber would have to fly very low in order to inflict any damage upon the submarine. This, however, gave the submarines a clear and easy shot at any incoming attackers.

==Behind the scenes==
Bonus unlockable concept art for a "combat speeder" in the video game [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] is nearly identical in appearance to Imperial submarines.
